posts.title: Anti-Patterns in Software Blogging
posts.description: In software development, we collect anti-patterns to recognize common traits that lead to poor outcomes in our software. posts.title: How to Write an Effective Software Design Document
posts.description: A good design doc can save you years of development time. Writing a design doc forces you to think through important decisions before you waste time on the wrong implementation.
